sources: Which? (24 November 2023), 'Only 2% of discounted products are cheapest on Black Friday': 208 tech, home and personal-care products on sale on Black Friday 2022 (25 Nov 2022) at eight UK retailers (Amazon, AO, Argos, Boots, Currys, John Lewis, Richer Sounds, Very); prices tracked daily for six months before and after. 5 of 208 (2 %) cheapest on Black Friday; 98 % the same price or cheaper at another time. With a wider window (18 Nov – 2 Dec 2022, incl. Cyber Monday) still 86 %.
Caveat: UK retailers, one year (2022), selected product categories; not a random sample of all deals.
